title: Button
description: Fiori button designs: default, emphasized, transparent, positive, negative, attention.

usage.summary: Trigger an explicit action with priority and semantic intent.
useWhen: Let users create, edit, save, approve or cancel an explicit action.
Reserve variant="emphasized" for one primary action per page or dialog; use positive and negative only for positive and negative semantic actions.
Use imperative verb labels such as Save or Reject; allow up to 300% text expansion in translations.
Keep primary, secondary, semantic and negative-path actions as text buttons.
Give recognizable icon-only actions both a tooltip and an accessible label.

avoidWhen.when: Navigate to a page, object or external URL.
Keep an action visibly active until the user turns it off.
Choose related view options, one form option or independent form options.
Navigate through a guided sequence of task steps.
